name: ethos-gtm
description: Use Cluster through its hosted MCP server for GTM prospecting, enrichment, tables, agent columns, read-only multi-dimensional analytics, and cross-channel unibox conversations.

interface.shortDescription: GTM prospecting, campaigns, analytics, and a cross-channel unibox.
interface.longDescription: Use Cluster through a remote OAuth-backed MCP server. Find prospects, enrich contact info, build and operate campaigns, compare campaigns, sender accounts, and channels with canonical metric definitions, drill into contributors, manage replies, and configure workflows. The complete granular tool catalog is exposed directly, while current multi-step workflow guidance is available from live MCP resources.

Use Cluster to build an email and LinkedIn campaign from my people table.
